description: Na₆Mg(SbO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SbO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one SbO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one SbO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SbO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.65 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.62 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.74 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.73 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.54 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and corners with two equivalent SbO₄ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-46°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.04 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted SbO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one SbO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.29 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SbO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.25 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₅Sb octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Sb₂ trigonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Sb trigonal pyramid, edges with two equivalent ONa₄Sb₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Sb₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Sb trigonal pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Sb atoms to form distorted ONa₄Sb₂ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Sb₂ trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent ONa₅Sb octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Sb₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Sb trigonal pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Sb atoms to form distorted ONa₃Sb₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two ONa₅Sb octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Sb trigonal pyramids, edges with two ONa₅Sb octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Sb trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-68°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₃Sb trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Sb octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Sb₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two ONa₅Sb octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Sb₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°.
